g.title: PACK
g.text: Vehicle's own. Sealed 12 V pack. ALWAYS LIVE.

g.title: J_PACK
g.text: MRider's half. Opposite gender to the pack.

g.title: W_IN
g.text: Pack + to the fuse. MRider's own wire - the bought tab crimps onto THIS.

g.title: W_NEG
g.text: Pack - straight to the XT60. Through nothing.

g.title: W_K
g.text: Switched +. Dead when the E-stop is pressed.

g.title: J_ECU
g.text: MRider's half. Receives the stock male lead.

g.title: ECU
g.text: Vehicle's own, on to the stock 10 A protector.
